```{r setup}
params <- list(
  seed = 12435,
  workers = 4,
  interactive = TRUE,
  prior_count = 2,
  gene_fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  pathway_fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  data_dir = "../data/",
  rds_dir = "../results/rds/",
  table_dir = "../results/tables/",
  fig_dir = "../results/figures/",
  msigdb_dir = "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"
)

if(!dir.exists(params$rds_dir)){
  dir.create(params$rds_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(params$table_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(params$fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Load packages ----------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(yaml)

  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(unikn)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(dplyr)

})

# Load functions ---------------------------------------------------------------
source("../../scripts/functions.R", local = TRUE)
source("../../scripts/GSEA_camera.R")
source("../../scripts/makeFitObject.R")

# Load globals -----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(params$seed)

msigdb_dir <- "../../references/MSigDb_2025.1/"

de_table_cols <- c(
  "GENEID", "SYMBOL", "DESCRIPTION", "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

round_de_table_cols <- c(
  "logFC", "logCPM", "F", "PValue", "FDR"
)

shiny_path <- file.path(
  params$rds_dir, "shiny", "rds"
)
```

# Load data

```{r load-data}
dat <- as.data.frame(fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "KL7BFC_results", "KL7BFC-expression-matrix.tsv")))

count_cols <- grep("^KL7BFC_[0-9]+_count$", colnames(dat), value = TRUE)
cnts <- as.matrix(dat[, count_cols])
colnames(cnts) <- sub("_count$", "", colnames(cnts))
rownames(cnts) <- dat$gene_id

meta_sample <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "KL7BFC_results", "KL7BFC-mapping-stats-reads.csv"))
setnames(meta_sample, 1, "SampleDescriptor")

treatment_lookup <- c(
  "VEH" = "Vehicle",
  "AZA+Tc" = "AZA_Tcells"
)

grp <- meta_sample |>
  mutate(
    OriginalSampleName = paste0("KL7BFC_", 1:20),
    Condition = str_extract(SampleDescriptor, "NTC|KO"),
    TreatmentCode = str_extract(SampleDescriptor, "VEH|AZA\\+Tc"),
    Treatment = treatment_lookup[TreatmentCode],
    Replicate = str_extract(SampleDescriptor, "rep_[0-9]+"),
    sex = "NA",
    CellLine = "NA"
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()

rownames(grp) <- grp$OriginalSampleName

cnts <- cnts[, match(grp$OriginalSampleName, colnames(cnts))]
stopifnot(all(grp$OriginalSampleName == colnames(cnts)))

grp$Condition <- factor(grp$Condition, levels = c("NTC", "KO"))
grp$Treatment <- factor(grp$Treatment, levels = c("Vehicle", "AZA_Tcells"))
grp$SampleGroup <- factor(
  paste(grp$Condition, grp$Treatment, sep = "_"),
  levels = c(
     "NTC_Vehicle", "KO_Vehicle", "NTC_AZA_Tcells", "KO_AZA_Tcells"
  )
)

gnes <- data.frame(
  Symbol = dat$gene_name,
  DESCRIPTION = NA_character_,
  GENEID = dat$gene_id,
  gene_biotype = dat$gene_biotype,
  SYMBOL = dat$gene_name
)
rownames(gnes) <- gnes$GENEID

library(org.Mm.eg.db)
desc_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys      = gnes$GENEID,
  column    = "GENENAME",
  keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)
gnes$DESCRIPTION <- unname(desc_map[gnes$GENEID])

dge <- DGEList(
  counts = cnts,
  samples = grp,
  genes = gnes
)

rownames(dge$genes) <- dge$genes$GENEID
rownames(dge) <- dge$genes$GENEID

gene_sets <- readRDS(file.path(params$msigdb_dir, "msigdb_v2025.1.Mm_gene_sets.rds"))
```

# Create design matrix

```{r design}
moma <- model.matrix(~ 0 + SampleGroup, data = dge$samples)
colnames(moma) <- sub("SampleGroup", "", colnames(moma))
```

# Transform and filter data

```{r}
dge_unfilt = dge
dge <- dge[filterByExpr(dge, design = moma), , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
```

# Calculate normalization factors and dispersions

```{r calculate-norm-factors-dispersions}
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design = moma)
log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = params$prior_count)
```

# Create contrasts

```{r contrasts}
contrast_vec <- c(
  "KO__vs__NTC_Vehicle"     = "KO_Vehicle - NTC_Vehicle",
  "KO__vs__NTC_AZA_Tcells"  = "KO_AZA_Tcells - NTC_AZA_Tcells",

  "INT_AZA_Tcells"  = "(KO_AZA_Tcells - KO_Vehicle) - (NTC_AZA_Tcells - NTC_Vehicle)"
)

cntrs <- makeContrasts(
  contrasts = contrast_vec,
  levels = moma
)
colnames(cntrs) <- names(contrast_vec)
```

# Fit model and contrasts

```{r model-fit}
fit <- glmQLFit(dge, moma, prior.count = 2)
plotQLDisp(fit, main = "Quasi-likelihood dispersion")
```

```{r contrast-fit}
fits <- map(
  colnames(cntrs),
  ~ perform_contrast_fit_edgeR(fit, .x, cntrs)
) |> rlang::set_names(colnames(cntrs))
```

# Differential expression result tables {.tabset}

```{r de-tables, results='asis'}
tt_list <- lapply(names(fits), function(fn) {
  tt <- as.data.frame(topTags(fits[[fn]], n = Inf))
})

names(tt_list) <- names(fits)

pval_cols  <- intersect(c("PValue", "FDR", "P.Value", "adj.P.Val"), round_de_table_cols)
other_cols <- setdiff(round_de_table_cols, pval_cols)

for (fn in names(tt_list)) {
  h2(fn)
  print(htmltools::tagList(
    default_dt(
      tt_list[[fn]][, de_table_cols] |>
        dplyr::filter(FDR < params$gene_fdr_threshold)
    ) |>
      formatSignif(columns = pval_cols, digits = 3) |>
      formatRound(columns = other_cols, digits = 2)
  ))
  cat("  \n")
}
```

# GSEA analysis

```{r}
fits4gsea <-  fits
rownames(dge) <- dge$genes$GENEID
```

```{r}
perform_gsea <- function(fit, gene_set, min = 10, max = 200) {
  if (is.null(fit$table$logFC)) {
    warning("Data doesn't contain gene LogFC values, LogFC data will not be available for pathways.")
  }

  if (is.null(fit$gseaStatistics)) {
    return(data.frame())
  } else {
    indx <- gene_set %>%
      ids2indices(identifiers = rownames(fit$gseaStatistics$U))

    indx <- indx[map_int(indx, length) %>% between(min, max)]

    res <- cameraStats2Table(
      cameraStat = fit$gseaStatistics,
      index = indx,
      geneLog2FC = fit$table$logFC
    )
    return(res)
  }
}
```

```{r gsea}
collections <- unique(sort(gene_sets$collection_name)) |>
  rlang::set_names()

fits4gsea <- map(fits4gsea, ~ add_camera_stats(.x, eset = dge))

compute_fraction_overlap <- function(fit, gene_set, min = 10, max = 200) {
  indx <- gene_set %>%
    ids2indices(identifiers = rownames(fit$gseaStatistics$U))

  fractions <- sapply(indx, length) / sapply(gene_set[names(indx)], length)

  indx <- indx[map_int(indx, length) %>% between(min, max)]
  fractions <- fractions[names(indx)]

  data.frame(FractionOverlap = fractions)
}

add_leading_genes <- function(res, gene_set, identifiers) {
  if (nrow(res) == 0) return(res)

  indx <- ids2indices(gene_set, identifiers = identifiers)
  res$FractionOverlap <- purrr::map_dbl(
    rownames(res),
    ~ length(indx[[.x]]) / length(gene_set[[.x]])
  )
  res$overlapGenes <- purrr::map_chr(
    rownames(res),
    ~ paste(identifiers[indx[[.x]]], collapse = ",")
  )
  res
}

gsea_res <- map(collections, function(co, gene_sets) {
  gs <- as.list(gene_sets[gene_sets$collection_name == co, "ensembl"])

  map(fits4gsea, function(fit) {

    res <- perform_gsea(fit, gs, min = 15)

    if (nrow(res) == 0) return(res)

    frac <- compute_fraction_overlap(fit, gs)
    res <- merge(res, frac, by = "row.names")
    rownames(res) <- res$Row.names
    res$Row.names <- NULL

    res$log2FC <- ifelse(res$Direction == "Down", -1*res$absLog2FC, res$absLog2FC)
    res$abslog2FC <- NULL
    identifiers <- rownames(fit$gseaStatistics$U)
    add_leading_genes(res, gs, identifiers)
  })
}, gene_sets = gene_sets, .progress = params$interactive)
```

```{r export-gsea-tables, eval=params$run_gsea}
gsea_res_dfr <- lapply(names(gsea_res), function(x) {
  lapply(names(gsea_res[[x]]), function(y) {
    gsea_res[[x]][[y]] |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Pathway") |>
      mutate(Contrast = y, .before = 1) |>
      mutate(MsigDb = x, .before = 1)
  }) |>
    bind_rows()
}) |>
  bind_rows()

write.table(
  gsea_res_dfr,
  file.path(
    params$table_dir,
    paste0("gsea_all.txt")
  ),
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

write_xlsx(
  gsea_res_dfr,
  file.path(
    params$table_dir,
    paste0("gsea_all.xlsx")
  )
)

write_xlsx(
  gsea_res_dfr |>
    dplyr::filter(FDR < params$pathway_fdr_threshold),
  file.path(
    params$table_dir,
    paste0("gsea_sig.xlsx")
  )
)
```

```{r export-for-shiny, eval=params$run_gsea}
if (!dir.exists(shiny_path)) {
  dir.create(shiny_path, recursive = TRUE)
}

saveRDS(dge, file = file.path(shiny_path, "expression_set.rds"))

log2cpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
iqrs <- apply(log2cpm, 1, IQR)
varCut <- 0.75
sel <- iqrs > quantile(iqrs, varCut)
pca <- prcomp(
  scale(t(scale(t(log2cpm[sel, ]), scale = FALSE)), scale = FALSE),
  center = FALSE
)
saveRDS(pca, file = file.path(shiny_path, "expression_set_pca.rds"))

saveRDS(log2cpm, file = file.path(shiny_path, "log2cpm.rds"))

cor_df <- expression_set_correlation(log2cpm)
saveRDS(
  cor_df,
  file = file.path(shiny_path, "expression_set_correlation.rds")
)

saveRDS(fits, file = file.path(shiny_path, "limma_results.rds"))

saveRDS(
  makeFitObject(fits),
  file = file.path(shiny_path, "limma_results_shiny.rds")
)

saveRDS(fits, file = file.path(shiny_path, "limma_results.rds"))

saveRDS(gsea_res, file = file.path(shiny_path, "gsea_all.rds"))

if (any(lapply(gsea_res, length) > 0)) {
  saveRDS(
    gsea_res,
    file = file.path(shiny_path, "camera_results.rds")
  )
}
```
